title: Barbers
description: Provide barbering services, such as cutting, trimming, shampooing, and styling hair; trimming beards; or giving shaves.

tasks.text: Clean and sterilize scissors, combs, clippers, and other instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Tool cleaning is physical manipulation

tasks.text: Cut and trim hair according to clients' instructions or current hairstyles, using clippers, combs, hand-held blow driers, and scissors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hair trimming is hands-on with unpredictable clients

tasks.text: Question patrons regarding desired services and haircut styles.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Client service-option discussion needs human relationship

dwas.name: Discuss service options or needs with clients.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Clean work stations and sweep floors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cleaning of facilities and work areas

tasks.text: Drape and pin protective cloths around customers' shoulders.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual application of protective coverings

dwas.name: Apply protective coverings to objects or surfaces near work areas.

tasks.text: Apply lather and shave beards or neck and temple hair contours, using razors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hair trimming is hands-on with unpredictable clients

tasks.text: Record services provided on cashiers' tickets or receive payment from customers.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain financial records; human reconciles exceptions

tasks.text: Shape and trim beards and moustaches, using scissors.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hair trimming is hands-on with unpredictable clients

tasks.text: Perform clerical and administrative duties such as keeping records, paying bills, and hiring and supervising personnel.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Broad clerical tasks partly automatable, human oversees exceptions

tasks.text: Keep card files on clientele, recording notes of work done, products used and fees charged after each visit.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Maintain client records; human owns sensitive judgment

dwas.name: Maintain client information or service records.

tasks.text: Stay informed of the latest styles and hair care techniques.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI supports study; certification requires human

tasks.text: Shampoo hair.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying agents to hair and skin is hands-on care

dwas.name: Apply cleansing or conditioning agents to client hair, scalp, or skin.

tasks.text: Order supplies.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

tasks.text: Suggest treatments to alleviate hair problems.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Medical/cosmetic advice needs accountable clinical judgment

dwas.name: Provide medical or cosmetic advice for clients.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Curl, color, or straighten hair, using special chemical solutions and equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hair treatment application requires manual skill

dwas.name: Apply solutions to hair for therapeutic or cosmetic purposes.

tasks.text: Provide face, neck, and scalp massages.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Massage is skilled manual physical contact

tasks.text: Recommend and sell lotions, tonics, or other cosmetic supplies.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Promotional materials drafted; human executes outreach

tasks.text: Provide skin care and nail treatments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Nail shaping requires fine manual dexterity

dwas.name: Treat nails by shaping, decorating, or augmenting.
Apply cleansing or conditioning agents to client hair, scalp, or skin.

tasks.text: Identify hair problems, using microscopes and testing devices, or by sending clients' hair samples out to independent laboratories for analysis.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical sample collection

dwas.name: Collect samples for analysis or testing.
Prepare biological specimens for laboratory analysis.
Prepare biological samples for testing or analysis.

tasks.text: Measure, fit, and groom hairpieces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of material

dwas.name: Measure product or material dimensions.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Measure clients to ensure proper product fit.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information
